**Finding: compliant (no redline).**

The WARRANTY rule targets a vendor standing behind its own work. This document has no vendor counterparty: the Wet Segment is built by Suppliers under a separate Supply Contract, and the "other APCN 2 Parties" are our co-owners, not our supplier.

Key points:
- The only warranty-adjacent language is the Subparagraph 4.9 disclaimer (p0126–p0127), and it protects the **Procurement Group**. Under 3.8 (p0101) the PG is made up of representatives of each Initial Party, and Teleglobe is an Initial Party (p0053) — so the disclaimer runs **in our favour**. Redlining it would cut against our own position.
- Real protection is passed through upstream: 4.6 (RFPA Date in the Supply Contract), 4.7 (examine/test/inspect rights), and 4.8 (p0124–p0125), under which the PG acts on behalf of the Parties to exercise Supply Contract remedies for specification failure, capacity shortfall or Supplier material breach. Paragraph 10 layers on continuing "efficient working order" maintenance duties plus a self-help remedy in 10.7.

Noted in the rationale but not flagged as deviations: no inter-Party conformance period or repair/replace/refund remedy, and no express-warranty carve-out from the disclaimer — there is simply no vendor here to bind to one.
